market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil spike and Fed hike expectations create headwinds. SaaS selloff may extend. Bond market asserting dominance over equities. Expect volatility around 10-year yield crossing 5% and any further Houthi escalation. FTSE 100 and energy names outperform; tech and rate-sensitive sectors lag.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive on AI infrastructure, energy transition (LNG), and defense. SaaS consolidation will create winners but destroy value. CRE bifurcates further. Fed hiking cycle likely 1-2 more moves before pause. AI safety debate (OpenAI IPO delay, Anthropic concerns) may slow deployment pace but not direction.
